Team Logic Overloads · Problem Statement 26033 · Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution

The shortest path from a farmer's field to your kitchen.

Kisan Setu is a direct farmer-to-consumer marketplace that removes unneeded middlemen, handles logistics end to end, and uses AI to help farmers grow the right crop, in the right amount, for the right buyer.

See the problem View the problem statement ↗
01 · The Problem

Every layer between the farm and the table takes a cut, and adds no value.

A tomato grown in Nashik passes through a commission agent, a wholesaler, and a retailer before it reaches a home in Mumbai. Each one takes a margin. None of them grew the crop, took on its weather risk, or made it fresher.

The result is a strange kind of loss: farmers earn a small share of what the consumer finally pays, while the consumer still pays a high price. There is no single, trusted digital channel today that lets a farmer sell straight to a buyer, get help with transport, and know in advance what the market actually wants.

What the farmer keeps~30–35%
What the consumer pays100%

Illustrative split for a typical mandi-to-retail chain with 3–4 intermediary layers. Kisan Setu is built to shorten this chain, not just make it more visible.

02 · The Solution

One platform, four working parts.

A web and mobile marketplace built around the things a farmer, a buyer, and a delivery partner each actually need on a normal Tuesday.

Marketplace

Listing, search & payments

Farmers and FPOs list produce with price, grade, and harvest date. Buyers search by crop, distance, and certification, and pay through escrow that releases on delivery.

Logistics

Pickup to doorstep

Scheduled farm pickup, route-matched vehicles, cold-chain flags for perishables, and OTP-confirmed delivery, so produce moves without a farmer chasing a truck.

AI / ML

Forecasting & routing

Demand forecasts by crop and region, fair-price suggestions against mandi data, and route optimisation that cuts fuel cost and spoilage.

Trust

Verification & grievance

KYC for farmers and FPOs, two-way ratings, quality grading, and a grievance workflow that DoCA can oversee end to end.

03 · Inside the Product

Built around what actually happens between harvest and delivery.

Listing & price discovery

Farmers and FPOs list quantity, harvest date, grade, and photos in a few steps, with bulk listing for FPOs acting on behalf of many member farmers. Every listing shows the farm-gate price next to the local mandi reference price pulled from Agmarknet, so nobody is guessing what's fair.

  • Location-based search with crop, price, and distance filters
  • Seasonal and category tagging, with inventory that updates as stock sells

Ordering & escrow payments

Individual consumers get a simple cart and checkout. Bulk buyers, restaurants, and caterers can set up standing or recurring orders. Payment sits in escrow until delivery is confirmed, which protects the farmer from a buyer who walks away and the buyer from produce that never shows up.

  • UPI, cards, net banking, wallet, and cash-on-delivery for local orders
  • Automatic invoices and a downloadable earnings history for farmers

Logistics & delivery

Once an order is placed, the platform schedules pickup from the farm or FPO collection centre and assigns a logistics partner by route and load. Perishable produce is flagged for cold-chain handling, and buyers can track the shipment in real time until an OTP or photo confirms delivery.

  • Community pickup points for areas without reliable last-mile delivery
  • Route optimisation that groups nearby pickups and drops

AI intelligence layer

Four models sit underneath the marketplace, each solving one narrow problem well rather than one model trying to do everything.

  • Demand forecasting by crop and region, using sales history, weather, and festival calendars
  • Dynamic pricing suggestions benchmarked against nearby mandi prices
  • Route optimisation across multiple pickup and drop points
  • Spoilage risk alerts that flag ageing stock before it's wasted

The Model Behind KisanSetu

Meet FasalIQ — a genuinely trained crop recommendation model.

Instead of hardcoded rules, FasalIQ is a real machine-learning classifier trained on real agricultural data — built to help farmers choose crops that are statistically well suited to their soil and climate, so they can grow toward better yield and better income.

2,200
Real samples, 22 crops
99.3%
Held-out test accuracy
10/10
JS ↔ Python predictions match exactly

What FasalIQ analyzes

Seven real soil and climate parameters go into every recommendation — no guesswork, no fixed lookup table.

  • Nitrogen (N) — soil nitrogen concentration
  • Phosphorus (P) — soil phosphorus concentration
  • Potassium (K) — soil potassium concentration
  • Temperature — real, live environmental temperature
  • Humidity — real, live atmospheric humidity
  • pH — soil acidity/alkalinity
  • Rainfall — real, live rainfall outlook for your location

Model & training

A Random Forest classifier (40 trees, depth 10) trained on a real agricultural dataset. The dataset was split into training and held-out test data — the test set was never seen during training, so the reported accuracy reflects genuine performance on new data.

Real-time web inference, not a server call to nowhere

FasalIQ isn't just a Python model sitting on a server. The exact trained forest was exported and paired with a JavaScript inference engine, so predictions run directly inside KisanSetu — verified against the original Python model with zero probability difference across every test case.

  • A decision-support tool, not a replacement for agricultural expertise
  • Built to help farmers identify crops statistically well suited to their real conditions
  • Designed for expansion — live weather, yield history, and disease detection can plug in over time

FasalIQ in one line

FasalIQ is KisanSetu's real-data-trained crop recommendation model — it uses real soil and climate parameters to identify the crop most likely to give a farmer the best yield and the best return, and says so honestly, with real confidence numbers instead of guarantees.

04 · Who It's For

Five roles, each with their own dashboard.

RoleWho they areWhat they can do
Farmer / FPO Individual farmer or a Farmer Producer Organisation Register, list produce, set quantity and expected price, receive orders, manage sales, arrange pickup
Consumer Buys produce for household use Search produce, compare prices, place small orders, track delivery
Bulk Buyer Restaurants, hotels, supermarkets, processors, canteens Find large quantities, contact farmers or FPOs, place bulk orders, schedule delivery
Transporter / Driver Handles pickup and delivery Accept pickup and delivery jobs, view route, update delivery status
Admin Government or platform operator Verify users, monitor orders, manage disputes, listings, and platform activity
05 · Under the Hood

An indicative build, chosen for speed and government-grade reliability.

Frontend & Auth

  • HTML, CSS, JavaScript — this page is the live prototype
  • Supabase Auth for role-based sign-up and login

Backend & Data — live

  • Supabase: Postgres, auto-generated REST API, row-level security
  • Tables for profiles, listings, orders, pickups, and demand forecasts
  • Django/DRF is still an option later for heavier server-side logic

Intelligence & Logistics

  • Python, pandas, scikit-learn for demand forecasting
  • A simple model to start, for the prototype
  • A maps and routing API for pickup/delivery routes
06 · Build Plan

Don't build everything. Make the core journey work end to end.

For a hackathon, the win is a complete farm-to-buyer loop, not a feature-complete app. Everything else waits.

Build first — the MVP

  • Role-based registration and login
  • Farmer creates a produce listing
  • Buyer searches and filters produce
  • Buyer sends an order or request
  • Farmer accepts or rejects the order
  • Order status tracking
  • Basic transport and pickup scheduling
  • Simple demand forecast dashboard using sample data
  • Simple route or map demonstration
  • Admin verification screen

Add later

  • Online payments and escrow
  • Real-time driver tracking
  • AI-based price recommendations
  • Advanced crop-demand forecasting
  • Quality or image-based crop inspection
  • Multilingual interface
  • Voice-based farmer assistance
  • IoT/sensor data for storage and transport
  • Warehouse or cold-storage integration
  • Advanced analytics for farmers and buyers

Success looks like money moving differently, not just an app existing.

↑ Accuracy
Forecast accuracy of the AI demand prediction model
08 · Risks We're Designing For

The failure modes we planned around before writing code.

Low digital literacy among farmers Voice/IVR support, WhatsApp ordering, assisted onboarding via FPOs
Trust deficit in online payments Escrow-based payments, cash-on-delivery for local orders, verified profiles
Logistics failure in remote areas Partnerships with local delivery networks and community pickup hubs
Patchy rural connectivity Offline-first design with sync-when-online
Price manipulation or fraud AI anomaly detection, admin oversight, grievance redressal

10 · Suggested User Flow

One order, start to finish.

  • Farmer registers, completes a profile, and gets verified
  • Farmer adds produce with quantity, price, location, and harvest/availability date
  • Buyer searches the marketplace, or posts a bulk requirement
  • The platform matches suitable farmers or FPOs
  • Buyer and farmer agree on quantity and price
  • An order is created
  • Transport is arranged and pickup is scheduled
  • Route and ETA are calculated
  • Produce is delivered, and the order is marked complete
  • Payment, invoice, and rating are recorded
11 · Help Centre

Questions people actually ask us.

Grouped by who's asking. If your question isn't here, the contact section below reaches the team directly.

For Farmers & FPOs

How do I prove who I am to list produce?+

You verify once, at signup, using your Aadhaar number or your FPO's registration number. After that, your listings carry a verified badge automatically, so you don't repeat KYC for every crop you list.

Do I have to set my own price?+

Yes. Kisan Setu shows you a suggested price range based on nearby mandi rates and current demand, but the final number is always yours. The suggestion is advisory, not a floor or a ceiling.

What if a buyer doesn't pay after I deliver?+

Payment is held in escrow from the moment an order is placed. It only releases to you once delivery is confirmed by OTP or photo, so a buyer can't walk away after you've already sent the produce.

I run an FPO. Can I list for multiple farmers at once?+

Yes, the bulk upload tool lets an FPO list produce on behalf of several member farmers in one pass, with member management to keep each farmer's earnings and history separate.

I'm not comfortable with smartphones. Can I still use this?+

You can get order and price alerts over SMS or WhatsApp instead of the app, and optional IVR voice support is planned for farmers who'd rather speak than type. FPOs can also assist with onboarding directly.

For Consumers & Bulk Buyers

How is the price on Kisan Setu different from my local market?+

Every listing shows the farm-gate price next to the local mandi reference price, pulled from Agmarknet. You're paying closer to what the farmer actually asked for, since fewer intermediaries are taking a cut in between.

What happens if my order arrives damaged or wrong?+

You can raise a return or refund request from your order history, and it's routed through the dispute resolution flow. Your payment stays in escrow until the issue is resolved, so you're not out of pocket while it's sorted.

Can I set up a recurring order for my restaurant or shop?+

Yes, bulk buyers can set up standing or recurring orders instead of placing a fresh order every time, which is built specifically for restaurants, retailers, caterers, and mandis.

How do I pay?+

UPI, cards, net banking, wallet, or cash-on-delivery for local orders. Every payment method routes through the same escrow protection.

For Logistics Partners

How do I get assigned deliveries?+

Once you're onboarded, the platform assigns pickups based on your route and current load, optimised to group nearby pickups and drops so you're not crossing your own path.

What counts as a completed delivery?+

A delivery is confirmed once the buyer enters the OTP you provide, or a photo is uploaded at the drop point. That confirmation is also what releases the farmer's payment from escrow.

How does cold-chain handling work?+

Perishable orders are flagged automatically at checkout, so you know before pickup whether a load needs refrigerated handling and can plan your route accordingly.

General

Is Kisan Setu a government app?+

Kisan Setu is a prototype built by Team Logic Overloads for Smart India Hackathon 2026, in response to Problem Statement 26033, sponsored by the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution. It's a hackathon submission, not a live government service.

What languages does the platform support?+

Hindi, English, and major regional languages are selectable at signup, since the people this is built for often aren't comfortable in English alone.

What happens to my data?+

See the Privacy Policy below for the full detail. In short, KYC and payment data is stored securely and used only to run the marketplace, not sold or shared for advertising.

Legal

Terms of use & privacy policy.

Written in plain language, since a marketplace built for farmers with limited digital literacy shouldn't hide behind legal jargon.

Terms of Use Eligibility & accounts Listings & transactions Payments & escrow Acceptable use Privacy Policy What we collect How data is used & shared Your rights
Prototype notice: this document is a hackathon draft for Smart India Hackathon 2026, Problem Statement 26033. It describes intended policy, not a live, legally binding agreement.

Terms of Use

These terms govern the use of the Kisan Setu prototype by farmers, FPOs, consumers, bulk buyers, logistics partners, and administrators. By creating an account, you agree to use the platform as described here.

Eligibility & accounts

  • Farmers and FPOs must complete KYC verification using an Aadhaar number or FPO registration number before listing produce.
  • Each account belongs to one role. A farmer who also wants to buy in bulk registers a separate buyer account.
  • You're responsible for keeping your login details private and for activity that happens under your account.

Listings & transactions

  • Farmers and FPOs are responsible for the accuracy of quantity, price, harvest date, and quality grade on their own listings.
  • Buyers are responsible for reviewing a listing, including its quality grade and farm-gate price, before placing an order.
  • Disputes over a completed order go through the in-app return, refund, or grievance flow before any other channel.

Payments & escrow

  • Payment is held in escrow from the time an order is placed until delivery is confirmed by OTP or photo.
  • Cash-on-delivery is available for local orders and is settled directly between buyer and delivery partner.
  • Refunds for damaged, mismatched, or undelivered produce are processed once a dispute is resolved through the platform.

Acceptable use

  • No fake listings, price manipulation, or misrepresenting produce quality or origin.
  • No harassment of other users through in-app chat or calls.
  • Admin accounts may suspend a listing or account under active investigation for fraud or a policy violation.

Privacy Policy

This section explains what Kisan Setu collects, why, and who it's shared with. The goal is to collect only what's needed to run the marketplace, and to say so plainly.

What we collect

  • Identity and verification data: name, phone number, Aadhaar or FPO registration number, used only for KYC.
  • Transaction data: listings, orders, payments, and delivery status.
  • Location data, used to show nearby listings and to route logistics partners.
  • Communication sent through in-app chat, SMS, or WhatsApp notifications.

How data is used & shared

  • KYC data is used only for identity verification and is not shown publicly on your profile.
  • Price and demand data may be aggregated and shown to the Department of Consumer Affairs for policy oversight, without identifying individual farmers or buyers.
  • Payment details are processed through the payment gateway partner and are not stored directly on Kisan Setu's servers.
  • Data is never sold to advertisers or third parties for marketing.

Your rights

  • You can request a copy of the data linked to your account.
  • You can request account deletion, subject to closing out any active orders or escrow holds first.
  • You can update your KYC, contact, or language preferences from your profile at any time.

Questions about this policy can go to the Get in Touch
